parameters.name: DatabaseId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the database that you want to delete.
> You can invoke the [ListDatabases](~~2758822~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID of the bastion host where the database instance that you want to delete resides.
> You can invoke the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query this parameter.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.
> For the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).
